claim: An RZX holds the snapshot it was recorded from, so intake can start from the RZX alone, but that snapshot can be a different build or state than the delivered .z80.

evidence.text: The build input is the RZX's embedded .z80 (nexclash.py rzx extract); an RZX alone is a complete intake.
The .z80 is at the loader (PC 0x5B89) but the RZX embeds its own snapshot with the game running and descrambled (start address 0xA1E6).
The RZX's embedded snapshot differs from the delivered file in 11,283 bytes of 0x6018-0xFFFF (another build); everything measured is the RZX's copy.
